supporting_observations.claim: At 13:44:32 UTC, the proxy recorded Julia's account requesting https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplehill-it/tools/main/u.ps1 and returned status 200.

At 14:18:02 UTC, a UserAssist registry value under Julia Frost's profile referenced the PowerShell executable path C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe; this is evidence of PowerShell use, but does not establish its launch time or command line.

The supplied records support that PowerShell was used on the alerted workstation and that a script was requested shortly after the reported approximate time, but do not establish that this download caused the reported window or that the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a PowerShell process-creation event, command line, or script contents for the reported window.
The proxy record shows a successful request but does not provide the downloaded script body or establish whether it was executed.
The UserAssist record identifies a PowerShell executable path but does not establish when it was launched or what it did.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually appeared at approximately 13:40 UTC, as reported.
Whether the downloaded u.ps1 script was executed, what it contained, or whether it made changes.
Whether the request to the GitHub repository was authorized or related to the reported PowerShell window.
Whether the activity caused compromise, persistence, data access, or other impact.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process telemetry for WS-JFROST-01 around 13:20–14:20 UTC, including PowerShell process creation, parent process, command line, and process tree.
PowerShell Operational logs and available script-block or module logging for the same period.
The downloaded u.ps1 content, hash, repository history, and evidence of whether it was saved or executed on the workstation.
Confirmation from Julia Frost or IT whether the GitHub request and PowerShell use were expected.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-JFROST-01 made proxy CONNECT requests to copilot.github.com and accounts.google.com. These records show tunnels, not what activity occurred through them; they are outside the alerted PowerShell activity.
